# Vessel data recording {#sec-app-recording}

[Informative]{.status}

Recording vessel data — in the spirit of the **small-vessel voyage data recorder** program —
needs what real-time sharing needs, applied over time:

- data with a **consistent meaning**, independent of the on-board network it came from (@sec-vocab-vessel-data);
- **integrity**, so that a recording can be shown not to have been altered (@sec-trust-security);
- tolerance of **intermittent connectivity**, recording on board and synchronizing ashore via the vessel's shadow when a link is available.
